title: Germany, Czechia & Austria
intro: After landing in Munich, I pick up the car and begin the first drive of The Long Way Around. The route crosses into Czechia for a short lakeside stop at Lipno before continuing east to Vienna.

stops.name: Munich Airport
stops.description: Arrival in Germany and the starting point of the European road trip.

stops.name: MOLO Lipno
stops.description: A short lunch and photo stop beside Lake Lipno, including the long pier extending over the lake.

stops.name: Vienna
stops.description: Continue into Austria and finish the first driving day in Vienna.
